question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want to see more Officer Monte?
Would you make a good cop?

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Monte drives the car towards downtown Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You sure about that, Dillinger? These goombas might be a little outside of your reach...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I think I can handle them.
Howard strolls out of the car and over to Ryan and Travis.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey there, guys. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What's it look like, quarterback?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like you're really sticking it to books.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: They suck!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! And this dumb place made me pay a late fee!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Now get out of our faces, or I'll show you what a `real` tackle feels like!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now get out of our faces, or I'll show you what a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] tackle feels like!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. Let's just make this quick, okay? See that car over there? Officer Monte's behind the wheel, and he's about to bust you for vandalism.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hate that guy!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Me too! I've already got two strikes, and I can't get a third!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I feel you. So let's make this easy. You guys hand me your spray paint cans and run for it, and I'll hold Officer Monte off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That... Or you'll have to deal directly with him.
Ryan and Travis look at each other...
Then toss Howard their spray cans and take off running!
A moment later, Howard strolls back to the cop car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Done and done.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I was hoping you'd arrest the two miscreants... But I suppose chasing them off is pretty good for a rookie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!
Howard climbs back into the car...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: M... Me? I don't know, Howard, those guys are pretty tough...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which is why you'll use your superior intellect to talk them down! Go on, Erik! I have total faith in you!
Erik climbs out of the car and nervously makes his way towards Ryan and Travis...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey there, fellas. What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What's it look like, dork? We're tagging this building!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ah, yes, well, perhaps you might consider not doing that, seeing as how it is in violation of several city ordinances...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May I recommend taking up a hobby instead? Origami, perhaps? Because let me tell you, I could make paper cranes all day...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey, Ryan... Isn't this the dork that beat you up?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Shut up! He got lucky!
Travis walks over to Erik and lifts him up by the shirt collar.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm going into a dumpster, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yup.
Suddenly, there's the piercing shriek of a police whistle! Officer Monte comes sprinting over!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Drop the boy! Hands in the air! Backs to the wall! On your knees!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Too many instructions!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Book it!
Travis drops Erik, and he and Ryan take off in a sprint! Officer Monte walks over and helps Erik to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Son, I am `very` disappointed in you! Where was your inner fire? Where was your righteous rage?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Son, I am [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] disappointed in you! Where was your inner fire? Where was your righteous rage?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know if I have any of that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You sicken me. Now come on!
Erik climbs back into the car...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally! Some common sense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's get this over with!
Colt hops out of the car and strolls over to Travis and Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Caveman and Creeper! Drop the spray cans and put your hands in the air!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah? Or what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt winds up and decks Travis with a hard right hook!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Hey!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ryan blasts his spray paint at Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You pathetic, little...
Colt dives forward, tackling Ryan to the ground! The two wrestle furiously...
Suddenly, there's the piercing screech of a police whistle as Officer Monte comes running over!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: 5-0, 5-0! Book it!
Ryan disentangles himself from Colt, and the two guys take off running! Monte grabs Colt by the shirt and pulls him up to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What in tarnation was that about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You told me to take 'em out! That's what I did!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Look here, son. This isn't the good old days! You can't just go around beating up suspects!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Like it or not, you've got to follow rules and protocols... And that was way out of line!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Says you...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Back in the car! Now!
Colt hops back into the cop car...
A few minutes later, the three guys sit in the back of Officer Monte's car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, this sucks.
Monte hops in the front, revs the engine, and starts slowly cruising down the street...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Listen up, you miserable delinquents. There are three qualities that every good police officer needs to have.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A strong, vigilant sense of justice...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A keen, razor-sharp insight into the human mind...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And a dashing, manly sense of style!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean your lame old-man mustache?
Monte slams the brakes! Colt flies forward and smashes his face into the barrier between the front and back seat!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's why I wear a seatbelt!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Denigrate the mustache one more time, boy, and I swear on my great grandma Pablo, I will throw you out of this car myself!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just play along, would you, Colt? It's your fault we're in this mess!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm confused. Are we supposed to grow mustaches? Because I've been trying for a while, and it's not working...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! The truth is, you pipsqueaks couldn't begin to handle a mustache. No, you'll have to start a lot lower than that.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I didn't want to give you these at first... But I figured, if I'm going to reform you miscreants, I might as well do it right!
Officer Monte throws three pairs of aviator sunglasses into the backseat.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know, Colt, I think it's pretty cool...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, sunglasses? `Indoors?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, sunglasses? [color=#e23b3b][i]Indoors?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The eyes are the window to the soul... And a good officer never bares his soul to anyone! Now put them on!
Colt and Howard quickly put on their sunglasses. Officer Monte starts driving again.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now then. Centerscore might seem like a benign little town to you three... But actually, it's a hotbed of criminal activity!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Jaywalkers... Public loiterers... People that talk in the theater...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That sounds pretty benign...
Officer Monte slams on the brakes again! Colt flies forward and smashes into the barrier!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Seriously, Colt. Seatbelts save lives!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Erik, I am going to punch you in the...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Silence! Both of you! There is crime afoot!
Officer Monte points out the window, where just down the street, Ryan and Travis are spray painting the side of the town library.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Books suck'. Real clever, guys.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Normally, I'd walk out there and take down those two miscreants myself... But today, I'd like to see one of you do it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One of us, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You go left, I go right. 3... 2... 1... Go!
Howard and Colt take off running in opposite directions! Howards sprints as fast as he can, bounding down the street...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, come on...
Howard swings around a corner and dives into a store!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... I can't believe it... But I think I actually got away!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh really?
Howard spins around and finds Officer Monte sitting behind the register!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah! How did you get there?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Criminology 101. Know where your suspect is going to run. I already caught your friend making a beeline for his motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now then... Wanna make another run for it? Because I'd love to show you just how fast these thick, muscley calves can run.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, sir...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt, too dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your loss, slowpoke.
Colt takes a deep breath... Then takes off in a sprint!
Officer Monte turns around.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Figured he'd do that.
Very casually, Officer Monte reaches into his car and pulls out a `bola`, two interconnected cords with weights on the end!
nodes.text_bbcode: Very casually, Officer Monte reaches into his car and pulls out a [b]bola[/b], two interconnected cords with weights on the end!

nodes.text: He winds up, swings the bola over his head, and throws! It whistles neatly through the air and wraps around Colt's legs!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggh!
Colt falls down, slamming into the pavement!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where did you learn to do that?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: When I was a young man, I spent six months on a secret island in the South Pacific, learning to hunt the most dangerous game of all...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Man?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Miniature goat.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now get in the car!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the spirit, Big Eyes!
Colt turns towards the Principal's door, slides in a pair of paperclips, and starts fiddling around...
A moment later, it swings open!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boom! Still got it!
Colt and Erik run into the Principal's office!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Erik! Hack into the Principal's files!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Okay!
Erik runs up to the computer... And begins shouting at it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Computer... Activate! Open all files on Colt Warren! Delete all records!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you serious?! That's the best you can do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Trick question! I'm `already` in trouble!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Trick question! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]already[/i][/color] in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but Erik and I aren't!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And is that any way to live life? Terrified of getting in trouble? Do you know where that rabbithole leads?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll tell you. You're forty-five. You sell insurance for a living. You wake up at 7 am every morning, eat your fiber, and pull on a plaid button-down shirt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When you come home from work, you heat up a microwave dinner and veg out watching 'Boring Hospital'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And every night before you fall asleep, you think to yourself... Why didn't I take more risks? `Why didn't I take more risks?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And every night before you fall asleep, you think to yourself... Why didn't I take more risks? [color=#e23b3b][i]Why didn't I take more risks?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, come on, you're exaggerating...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what they'll write on your tombstone. 'Howard. The dude that never took any risks.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know, Howard, that sounds pretty bad... Maybe we should go along with what Colt says...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I'll stand here and look out. But that's it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you talking about? It's fool-proof!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Obviously we have pretty different definitions of fool-proof. For starters, I don't think Erik even knows how to hack...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More importantly, do you think deleting the files will honestly change anything? It's not like Principal Dyre is going to `forget` that you're supposed to be in detention!
nodes.text_bbcode: More importantly, do you think deleting the files will honestly change anything? It's not like Principal Dyre is going to [color=#e23b3b][i]forget[/i][/color] that you're supposed to be in detention!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you! Now can we all just go home?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, you're right that deleting the files won't be enough! I'm also going to have to write an incriminating letter from Dyre's computer to the Mayor! That'll be sure to get him fired!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I feel like you're getting the wrong message from this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, you don't want to risk your neck for me, that's fine. But even you have to admit that Dyre is `killing` this school! Didn't he make your girlfriend do 10 hours of community service for being late for class?
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, you don't want to risk your neck for me, that's fine. But even you have to admit that Dyre is [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] this school! Didn't he make your girlfriend do 10 hours of community service for being late for class?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Exactly! If you won't do this for me... Do it for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fine. I'll stand here and look out. But that's it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That makes me the bad cop! Let's do this!
Colt steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, man. We don't want to hurt you. Let's just do this the easy way, okay?

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what if I don't do what you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Then we'll be really mean to you!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: ...You'll be mean to me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! We'll call you all kinds of names! Like... Dumb Hair Guy! Or... Beady Eyes Dude!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm gonna get back to stealing these animals.
The animal thief turns back to the gate and resumes fiddling with the lock. Colt turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'We'll call you names'? That's the baddest you could do?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's really mean when people call you names!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, here's one for you... 'The Guy That Let The Animal Thief Get Away!'

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Heh! That `is` a pretty good one!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh! That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a pretty good one!

nodes.text: The animal thief manages to pry the lock off... And that's when the puma kitten lunges out of the sack and latches onto his face!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Aggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go kitten!
The thief falls backwards, struggling with the kitten! The lizards run out of the sack and scurry in all directions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Does this count as a win? I hope this counts as a win...
Just then, Howard and Officer Monte come sprinting around the corner! Monte grabs the kitten, safely cradles it with one arm, and presses his boot on the thief's chest!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Dang!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now would you boys quit gawking and gather some lizards?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! That means I'm good cop!
Erik steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sir? Mr. Animal Thief Sir? We'd really appreciate it if you put the animals down...

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Yeah? Or else what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or else... We're going to have do things the hard way!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You gonna arrest me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, no. See, we're `not` police... Which means we don't have to do things the police way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, no. See, we're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] police... Which means we don't have to do things the police way!

nodes.text: Colt takes out his cell phone and snaps a picture of the animal thief!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: What... What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It would appear that he's taking your picture!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's right. And you know why?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So I can post it `all over the Internet` and identify you as the guy that steals baby animals from the zoo!
nodes.text_bbcode: So I can post it [color=#e23b3b][i]all over the Internet[/i][/color] and identify you as the guy that steals baby animals from the zoo!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: So... So what? What do I care? I don't even use the Internet...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, you don't... But I bet your `daughter` does!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you don't... But I bet your [color=#e23b3b][i]daughter[/i][/color] does!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What would she think if she found out her precious new kitten was stolen from the zoo?!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: No! Please! I can't let her find out what I do!
Just then, Officer Monte and Howard come running up! The thief hands over the animals to Monte!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Great work, boys! I couldn't have done it better myself!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, that's not true. I could have done it somewhat better. But still! Pretty good job!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh! Thanks!
Meanwhile, Colt and Erik sprint through the zoo as fast as they can... And find a husky man at the locked park exit, holding a sack of lizards, and a puma kitten!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Oh no! It's the Junior Police!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not getting out of here, you animal-stealing scumbag!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you need them for, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: The lizards are for resale as exotic pets...

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: And the puma kitten is for my daughter, because I think he is adorable.

nodes.speaker: Animal Thief
nodes.text: Now what are you gonna do to stop me?
The animal thief turns around and begins fussing with the lock...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do we do, Colt? I don't want to fight him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then we're just going to have to talk him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good cop, bad cop?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! I'll call them! What are their names?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, `we're` the good cop and the bad cop!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#e23b3b][i]we're[/i][/color] the good cop and the bad cop!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! Which one are you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good question! I'm the...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aarrrrggh! Raarrr! Go away, you big, dumb bear!
The bear pauses for one moment...
Then steps closer to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, right! These are `zoo` bears! They're used to big crowds and loud noises!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, right! These are [color=#e23b3b][i]zoo[/i][/color] bears! They're used to big crowds and loud noises!

nodes.text: The bear rears up... Leans over Howard...
And that's when Officer Monte delivers a blisteringly fast karate kick to the bear's face!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grraawww!
The bear stumbles away with a sad, moaning sound! It clutches the side of its head with one paw!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Stupid boy! Look what you made me do! I didn't want to hurt it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean... You could have done that at `any time?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean... You could have done that at [color=#e23b3b][i]any time?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Of course! But I would never want to hit such a majestic, beautiful creature! This is going to really hurt my standing with Ka'chool, King of the Bears!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's climb out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Monte. Just back away from the bear... Very slowly...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But... What if he attacks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's a zoo bear. He's totally used to people and won't attack us... So long as we don't provoke him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Heh... I think you're right!
Howard and Monte very slowly step away from the bear and back up towards the side of the pen...
The bear eyes them... Then flops down with lazy disinterest.

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Raargh.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Good thinking, boy...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now help me get out of this pen!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wow, guys. We `really` did not do a good job with these tasks...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, guys. We [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] did not do a good job with these tasks...

nodes.text: Erik enters a crowded frat party. Frat guys crowd around a table. Girls dance in the middle of the room. Other college students mill about.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow, it's loud in here! Everyone has to shout just to have a conversation!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: College is so cool!
Erik scans the room for the source of all the sound... And finds a fancy speaker at the end of the room! A pounding bass line blasts out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jackpot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just need to make my way through the party and turn the music down... But I can't let anyone notice me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll need to act like a college guy... Blend in with the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Activate stealth camouflage!
Erik takes a deep breath... Then starts moving through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh really? By whom?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: By... Someone in... The frat?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh! Wait a minute! Are you Bryce's creepy cousin Fredrick from Amsterdam? He said you'd be showing up sometime this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes! That is me! I am the creepy cousin Fredrick! Fresh off the plane from Amsterdam!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now tell me, are there college girls here? I would like to smell their hair while dancing suggestively!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: ...Wow, Bryce wasn't kidding, was he?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope! I am as creepy as it gets!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Go on in, I guess... Just, you know, try not to skeeve the girls out `too` much...
nodes.text_bbcode: Go on in, I guess... Just, you know, try not to skeeve the girls out [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Danke!
Erik walks in. Dontae watches him go, then turns back to the Quad.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I'm like 95% sure that was German.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh really? Then why don't I know you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, you know, I'm real quiet. I mostly keep to my room, study, that kind of thing. You probably just didn't notice me.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Didn't notice you, huh? Let me ask you a question. What does `MAN` stand for?
nodes.text_bbcode: Didn't notice you, huh? Let me ask you a question. What does [color=#e23b3b][i]MAN[/i][/color] stand for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Men... Admiring... Nutcrackers?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What's the name of the frat president?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Barry?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Barry what?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Barry Banana?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Barry Banana. President of Men Admiring Nutcrackers.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I nailed it, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: `No!` Now get out of here, before I call the campus police, you pint-sized creep!

nodes.text: Well, well, well. When Viktor said he had some bad eggs for me to straighten out, I knew to expect troublemakers... But even I didn't expect a lot like this.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You straighten bad eggs? That explains why my omelets taste so funny...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Officer Monte, sir, I can assure you, this is all a misunderstanding...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't you talk to me, Sundance. I know exactly who you are. The bad boy who busted boldly out of Boot Camp, the one that got away!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was hoping you wouldn't remember that...
Monte strolls over to Colt and leans right into his face...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And you! My nemesis! My bane! The baddest kid in town... And the most satisfying to break!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, you smell like pastrami.
Monte turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And finally, we come to you... The third wheel on this little bicycle of crime. I don't know you, boy, and I don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Looking into your beady eyes, I see nothing. No light. No joy. Just the cold, black darkness of the abyss.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cooooool...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now then! Today is going to be the most meaningful day in your miserable lives. Today's the day it all turns around. Today is the day you become `men!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now then! Today is going to be the most meaningful day in your miserable lives. Today's the day it all turns around. Today is the day you become [color=#e23b3b][i]men![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Actually, I've already had my bar mitzvah!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm not talking about a bar mitzvah... I'm talking about a ridealong!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A whosie-what?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A ridealong! You'll join me as I make the rounds... Help me bust the city's lowlifes... And learn a valuable lesson about the dangerous, dirty, and poorly-lit road that crime takes you down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What if we refuse?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Then you'll be sitting front row on the fast train to Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't you own the Boot Camp? Isn't this a conflict of interest?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Actually, I sold the place to the Discipline Corporation... They made me an offer I couldn't refuse.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I miss the place, sure... But I'd like to believe it's in better hands.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And you'll be feeling just how rough those hands are unless you get into my car!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Please don't ever say that again.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now come on! Hop in!
Officer Monte turns to his car and opens the back door. Colt leans over to Howard and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Psst! Howard! I'm going to make a run for it! You in?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll be honest. It looks like you boys have a `lot` to learn before you can call yourselves `Junior Detectives!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be honest. It looks like you boys have a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] to learn before you can call yourselves [color=#e23b3b][i]Junior Detectives![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now, then! We're just going to swing by the station to see what crimes have been called in recently...
Officer Monte pulls up outside the Centerscore Police Station and takes the boys into his office...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh. This place is emptier than I thought it would be...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Heh! Sometimes it feels like I'm the only cop this dang town has!
Monte reads through some papers on his desk...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ah yes... Vandalism... Speeding violations... And some noise complaints... Boys, we have quite the exciting day planned for us...
Just then, a police radio on Monte's desk buzzes! A voice comes out... 'Officer Monte, this is dispatch. We've got a 341 at the 903. Want to check it? Over.'

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hmmm... Sounds like there's some monkey business going down at the zoo.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought that was the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sorry, boys, change of plans. I'm going to go investigate this zoo business... And you three are just going to have to take care of these crimes alone!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Alone? I don't know if I'm up for that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, isn't the point of a ridealong that we ride `along?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, isn't the point of a ridealong that we ride [color=#e23b3b][i]along?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Let me put it this way, boys. I'm putting you in charge of policework for the day. If you do a good job... I might just sign off on your Community Service.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And if not?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Then I hope you like footwear... Because you're going to `Boot Camp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I hope you like footwear... Because you're going to [color=#e23b3b][i]Boot Camp![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a terrible line!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: `You're a terrible line!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're a terrible line![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ahem.
Monte picks up his papers and hands them to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Here's what we've got on the docket, boys.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The Mad Egger of Maple Drive has struck again...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There have been reports of speeders downtown...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And apparently, there's been a bunch of noise complaints from a party at Centerscore U.!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now then. You'll find some gear under the desk... Citation papers, flashlights, walkie talkies...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me get this straight. You expect us... With no training... No experience... And no actual enforcement power of any kind... To crack all three of these cases?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've got your sunglasses, right? Good luck, you unruly hoodlums! I believe in you!
Monte turns and marches out of the station with a whistle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, this is just great. How do you guys want to tackle these?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's see... There's three cases... And three of us... Maybe we should each take one!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks for the obvious, Mathemagician.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I call dibs on the speeding, by the way. Bike cops are pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'll take this Mad Egger on Maple Drive... I live near there, and know the area pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guess that leaves me to break up this party.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've never been to a college party. Do you guys know what I should expect? Balloon animals? A clown?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... This is going to go `real` well.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... This is going to go [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] well.

nodes.text: The three guys split up and head off.

nodes.title: Officer Monte's Ridealong
nodes.subtitle: Can Colt, Howard, and Erik survive a day with Officer Monte?

nodes.text: Late one night at Centerscore High, Howard slowly makes his way down the school hallway...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello? Colt? I'm here, man... But I'm not really sure why...
Howard rounds a corner... And bumps right into Erik Ericson!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gah! You're not Colt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And neither are you...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did he text you too?
Howard takes out his phone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yep. 'Hey. Big Eyes. Come to the school. Principal's office. Emergency!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mine says the same thing... Except he calls me 'Nerdpants'...
Just then, Colt swings around the corner!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Big Eyes! Nerdpants! Am I glad to see you two!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Colt? It's 10 pm, and I had to skip out on a date with $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I walked for two hours...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I appreciate that, both of you. But right now, I `really` need your help.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I appreciate that, both of you. But right now, I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] need your help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See, our high and mighty dictator, Principal Dyre, sentenced me to a full year's worth of detention, which I think we can all agree is ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's why we're going to break into his office and edit the disciplinary records!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll jimmy the lock, Erik will hack into the computer, and Howard will stand guard and be a lookout!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...That's the only skill I bring to this team?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Howard, you've got ridiculously big eyes, okay? I'm just working with what you've been given.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know, Colt, I don't really like breaking the rules...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, why should we put our necks on the line for you? Don't you have some other goons who could help you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm offended! I don't think of you two as goons! I think of you as good, dear friends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Friends who owe me big favors!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Since when?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Since I helped you get your girlfriend that Christmas tree! And Erik, do I even need to mention the fight lessons?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Favor or not, I still don't think this is the best idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why the heck not?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I walked for two hours...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I appreciate that, both of you. But right now, I `really` need your help.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I appreciate that, both of you. But right now, I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] need your help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See, our high and mighty dictator, Principal Dyre, sentenced me to a full year's worth of detention, which I think we can all agree is ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's why we're going to break into his office and edit the disciplinary records!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll jimmy the lock, Erik will hack into the computer, and Howard will stand guard and be a lookout!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...That's the only skill I bring to this team?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Howard, you've got ridiculously big eyes, okay? I'm just working with what you've been given.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know, Colt, I don't really like breaking the rules...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, why should we put our necks on the line for you? Don't you have some other goons who could help you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm offended! I don't think of you two as goons! I think of you as good, dear friends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Friends who owe me big favors!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Since when?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Since I helped you get your girlfriend that Christmas tree! And Erik, do I even need to mention the fight lessons?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Favor or not, I still don't think this is the best idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why the heck not?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well...
Colt slams on the gas and chases after the red sports car! He tails it closely!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I've got you...
The red sports car swerves down a narrow alley!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not going to lose me `that` easily!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not going to lose me [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] easily!

nodes.text: Colt jerks his motorcycle, hard, and flies down the alley! He closes the gap towards the car...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stay on target... `Stay on target...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stay on target... [color=#e23b3b][i]Stay on target...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The car flies out onto the neighboring street! Colt pulls out after it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now watch `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now watch [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt pulls up in front of the car and brakes hard! The car screeches to a stop!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, there is `no way` I'm legally allowed to do that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, there is [color=#e23b3b][i]no way[/i][/color] I'm legally allowed to do that...

nodes.text: Erik pops up his collar and strolls confidently through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't mind me! Coming through! College life, am I right?
Bryce accidentally elbows Erik in the side!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa! Sorry, dude! You okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just fine, bro! Keeping it real! MAN Frat!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah! MAN! That's how we roll!
Erik eases past Bryce and walks through a circle of girls...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't know how I'm going to pass this anthro class... Have you seen how much field work we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's better than my film class... I've got a mid-term next week, and I still haven't watched half of these obscure Russian movies...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Professors! Classes! It's all just so much, am I right, ladies?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Who are you, again?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: MAN Frat! Whooo!
Erik walks off.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Geez. New pledges, right?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I know!
Erik finally clears the room and walks up to the sound system!
He leans over very discretely and turns the volume down...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey! What happened to the music?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Actually, I kind of like it... That music was `way` too loud!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I kind of like it... That music was [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too loud!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah! This way, we can actually have a conversation without shouting!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Oh... Okay... In that case...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Party on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe I should stay for a bit... A college party seems pretty fun...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Naw! I need to get back to the station and meet with the other guys! After all... A cop's work is never done!
Erik tries to cross the room...
But bumps right into Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yo, dude! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahem! Kind bro! I apologize for my rudeness! No ill will was intended!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: 'Kind bro'? What is the matter with you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nothing is the matter, bromo sapien! I am just a college guy like you! Let us enjoy merriment together!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Bryce, why is that guy talking like a robot?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Robot? I am... No robot! I am a frat brother! Good times had by all!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You sound a `lot` like a robot...
nodes.text_bbcode: You sound a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] like a robot...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Perhaps I am... A party bot?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey! Dontae! Why'd you let this weirdo in?
Dontae leans in the door.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: He said he was your creepy cousin Fredrick!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: First off, I said my cousin would be `SLEEPY` since he just flew in from Amsterdam...
nodes.text_bbcode: First off, I said my cousin would be [color=#e23b3b][i]SLEEPY[/i][/color] since he just flew in from Amsterdam...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And secondly, that isn't my cousin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Beep... Boop... Does not compute...
A few minutes later, Erik sits on the Centerscore U. quad. The party in the frat rages on, louder than ever.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... I suppose you can't win them all!
Colt slams on the gas and races after the red sports car! He tails it closely!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I've got you now...
The red sports car swerves down a narrow alley!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not losing me `that` easily!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not losing me [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] easily!

nodes.text: Colt swings a hard right... Too hard! He spins out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aggggh!
Colt's motorcycle jerks all over the road! He frantically tries to steer, flies through a red light...
And clips the side of a limo! It swerves off the road! Colt comes to a hard stop next to it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...
The limo door opens... And Tom Prince steps out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `You!` You just wrecked my limo... AGAIN!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color] You just wrecked my limo... AGAIN!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, dude, it's not what it looks like...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unbelievable! You just can't let something go, can you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm serious! I didn't do it on purpose! I turned over a new leaf! I'm not that guy anymore!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Really? You reformed? I did too!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? How's it going for you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, you know, ups and downs, peaks and valleys...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait a minute... If you're not a bad boy anymore, why'd you crash into my car?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm not a bad guy... But I'm not a very good cop, either!
Colt hops off his bike, checks his sunglasses, and approaches the sports car...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Supercop... Just give them a ticket and call it a day!
Colt steps up to the car... And finds it packed with Monarch Prep girls!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Okay, okay... You got us, Officer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We just wanted to take my daddy's sports car for a little joy ride!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Oh no... Are we in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Relax, Madisenn! We're just going to give this handsome officer a little 'donation'... And then he's going to let us go!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Isn't that right, `Officer?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Isn't that right, [color=#3b78e2][i]Officer?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Officer?' Why are they calling me that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They don't recognize me! It must be the shades and the veneer of authority!
Whose story do you want to see next?
Whose story do you want to see next?
That just leaves Howard! Let's see how he's doing...
That just leaves Howard! Let's see how he's doing...
That just leaves Colt! Let's see how he's doing...
That just leaves Colt! Let's see how he's doing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, guys. We `really` did not do a good job with these tasks...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, guys. We [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] did not do a good job with these tasks...

nodes.text: You must have honed your cop skills playing 'Cause of Death'... Because you are a `master` detective!
nodes.text_bbcode: You must have honed your cop skills playing 'Cause of Death'... Because you are a [b]master[/b] detective!

nodes.text: Enjoy your bonus scene, Supercop!
Meanwhile, behind the high stone walls of Boot Camp...
$Scott settles down at a cafeteria table! He stares at the bowl of gray goop on his tray...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Almost makes you miss Mystery Mystery...
Steve from Wilson High settles down next to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hey there, new fish. You're from Centerscore, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah. And you're from Wilson. Stan?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Steve. What'd you do?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Gave an inspiring speech encouraging the student body to disobey authority. Our crazy principal had his goons haul me off!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh! Me too! I tried to start a Steve-O-Lution at lunch... But Principal Dyre was having none of it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait... Dyre was the principal at Wilson, too?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh yeah! He totally ruined that school... Turned it into a prison state! Everyone who isn't an over-achieving butt-kisser has been sent here!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Alexei's here for being late for class three times... Sarah's here for falling asleep at an assembly... And Steph's here because she tossed a crumpled paper into a trash can...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I guess Dyre thought that was too close to 'playing sports!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But that's ridiculous! You can't send people to Boot Camp for things like that!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: That's what I said... And look where it got me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know exactly how you feel...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: See ya!
Steve walks off whistling, before a Discipline Corp. administrator yells at him. $Scott looks nervously around...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't believe it! Principal Dyre `destroyed` Wilson High... And he's going to do the same to Centerscore...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it! Principal Dyre [color=#e23b3b][i]destroyed[/i][/color] Wilson High... And he's going to do the same to Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And worst of all, I'm trapped here!
Yikes! Looks like $Scott is just starting to realize how `dire` the situation really is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yikes! Looks like $Scott is just starting to realize how [b]dire[/b] the situation really is!

nodes.text: Will he be able to do anything to save his school? Find out soon!
